goal: Independently review Developer authentication, lifecycle, RLS, immutable-code, and QA-boundary security.
decisions: Current-role checks protect Developer lifecycle mutations and note policies; QA approval and rejection remain outside the Developer-owned implementation.
The Reporter code-edit behavior remains editable while open and protected once in_progress.
acceptance_criteria: Only the currently authorized role can invoke protected lifecycle mutations.
Original report code remains immutable for every authenticated role after creation.
No unauthorized code, revision, note, or QA data is disclosed.
verification: Developer-focused review findings were remediated and role-demotion regressions were added.
Reporter code-edit policy now has regression coverage: edits are allowed while open and filtered after in_progress.
Full database verification passed after rebuilding the local Supabase database: 7 files and 143 tests.
